notes.title: 3D Aim Trainer - Get Ready to Compete!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 🎮

Big news coming your way! We're super excited to introduce a brand new feature to keep your gameplay fresh and thrilling: Daily Challenges! This is your chance to dive into a unique challenge every single day, compete with fellow gamers, and show off your mad skills. Let’s dive into what’s new and cool:

[i]What Are Daily Challenges?[/i]
[list]
[*] [b]New Challenge Every Day:[/b] Wake up to a fresh challenge each morning. Whether it's speed runs, precision targets, or puzzle madness, there's always something new.
[*] [b]Master and Collect:[/b] Not only do you get to master these challenges, but you also collect Challenge Tokens for each challenge you conquer.
[/list]

[i]Challenge Tokens - What’s the Deal?[/i]
Currently, these shiny tokens are your bragging rights. They showcase your overall prowess and dedication to the game. The more you collect, the more you stand out in the community.

[i]What’s Next for Challenge Tokens?[/i]
Here’s where it gets even more interesting. We’re brainstorming some cool ways to make these tokens more than just digital trophies. Think exclusive content, special in-game items, or maybe even unlocking secret levels. The possibilities are endless, and we’re just getting started!

[i]We Want Your Feedback![/i]
Your thoughts and feedback are what shape the game. As you dive into these Daily Challenges, let us know what you think! What do you love? What could be better? Your input might just influence what those Challenge Tokens can unlock in the future.

[i]Ready, Set, Go![/i]
So, what are you waiting for? Jump into the game, take on today's challenge, and start stacking up those tokens. This is just the beginning, and we've got plenty more in store for you. Stay tuned, keep playing, and most importantly, have fun!

As always, thanks for being an awesome part of our gaming community. Let’s make those Daily Challenges legendary!

Catch you in the game,
The 3DAT Team 🕹️✨

notes.title: 3D Aim Trainer - New level, better sound and visual improvements
notes.content:
Hey aimers! We've rolled out some thrilling updates in the latest patch that you're gonna love. Let’s dive into the details:

[h2]1. Post-Game V3 Overhaul: Visualize Your Victory![/h2]

We've given the post-game screen a major facelift, making it a feast for the eyes and more informative than ever. Now, it's a breeze to see how your score stacks up and how close you are to snagging the next medal. The visual overhaul takes the cake, giving you a clearer, more engaging way to track your progress. Get ready to see your hard work shine like never before!

[h2]2. New Level Alert: Tile Mania Hits Quick Play![/h2]

Gear up for Tile Mania, the latest addition to our quick play roster. This level isn't just about how fast you can flick; it's a true test of how well you prioritize targets. With its arcade-style vibe, Tile Mania forces you to think ahead and make split-second decisions, all while maintaining a breakneck pace. If you're looking to sharpen your target prioritization skills in a fun, challenging way, look no further!

[h2]3. 7.1 Sound Upgrade: Immerse Yourself in the Game![/h2]

We've completely overhauled our sound system to fully support 7.1 surround sound, elevating your gaming experience to new heights. This upgrade not only enhances the overall audio quality but also opens up new possibilities for level design, allowing us to create challenges that test and train your sound awareness like never before. Prepare to be fully immersed in the game world, with every sound cue adding depth and dimension to your play.

-----

Can't wait to see how these updates enhance your training experience! Keep aiming high, and let’s hit those targets with style. 🎧🎮🏆

notes.title: 3D Aim Trainer - Time For Brand New Assessments and More
notes.content:
Greetings, aimers! We're thrilled to introduce some exciting changes and enhancements in this latest update of 3D Aim Trainer. Let's dive into the details:

[h3]1. Assessment Overhaul: Sharpen Your Skills![/h3]

Prepare yourselves for a revamped and more challenging assessment experience! We've introduced all-new exercises meticulously designed to measure your aiming skills with precision. Each level is now divided into multiple stages, each testing different facets of the subskills they pertain to. We've introduced two distinct exercise types to keep you on your toes:

Survival-Based Exercises: Race against the clock to see how long you can survive before advancing to the next stage. It's a true test of your endurance, skill and adaptability.

Time-Based Exercises: Get ready for stages with fixed time limits, requiring you to showcase your aiming prowess swiftly and accurately.

Are you up for the challenge?

[h3]2. HUD Message Re-Do: Clarity and Style Unleashed![/h3]

We've given our HUD messaging a makeover to enhance clarity and aesthetic appeal. The improved design seamlessly integrates with our existing HUD, making it crystal clear what actions you need to take. Enjoy a sleeker and more user-friendly interface as you navigate through the game.

[h3]3. Quick Play Improvements: Fine-Tuning for Your Enjoyment![/h3]

We've fine-tuned several Quick Play levels to either boost performance or enhance the overall gameplay experience. Changes have been made to levels like Bot Flick, Attack Bombsite, Pigeon Squash, Bot Box, and more. Whether you're a seasoned player or a newcomer, these improvements aim to make your Quick Play sessions more enjoyable and accessible.

[h3]4. Game Feedback Evolution: Say Goodbye to the Side Bar![/h3]

We've bid farewell to the feedback bar on the right side of the screen during gameplay. Fear not, as we've retained the sound effect when achieving a new high score. It's all about streamlining your gaming experience while still celebrating your accomplishments with a burst of audio delight!

-----

Thank you for being part of the 3DAT community. Dive into the update, challenge yourself with the new assessment levels, and let us know your thoughts as you explore the enhanced features. Happy gaming!

notes.title: 3D Aim Trainer - Updated Badges, Medals and New Content.
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Highlights[/h1]
🔶 A new Quick Play level
🔶 New Medals designs
🔶 Score based medal system
🔶 Made all Academy levels selectable
🔶 Updated Fast Restart (shortcut Y)
🔶 Minor improvements

[h1]Patch Details[/h1]
🔶 A brand new Quick Play Level called SteelSeries Game On Challenge has been released. This is the second level we released that simulates a real in-game scenario that test all of your aim skills combined. Train yourself in positioning, crosshair placement and counter-strafing in order to master this level. Check it out.

🔶 We completely overhauled the way our Medals look. Go try them out on any Quick Play or Academy level. The tiers, from lowest to highest, are Iron, Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Ruby and Diamond. Each tier contains 5 medals to climb through. Go take a look!

🔶 The way we show how to reach the next medal has been updated too. Now you can easily look for the score to beat and get after it. This makes grinding for the medal a lot more intuitive.

🔶 From now on you can easily click on any Academy level to see what it's about. Whether you have unlocked or not. This will help players find the perfect exercise to complete their practice session.

🔶 A while ago we added the Fast Restart functionality (shortcut Y) and now we increased its functionality to make it even easier and smoother to restart any level in the game.

🔶 Tons of minor bug fixes (Bombspot Clear, Pigeon Squash, ...). Updated post-game restart and progress bar. Much more..

notes.title: 3D Aim Trainer Update Notes - New Quick Play Levels!
notes.content:
[h2]Patch Highlights[/h2]
🔶 14 New Quick Play Levels
🔶 Beginner Friendly Rookie Range
🔶 New Survival Mode Levels
🔶 Android Apocalypse
🔶 Updated Flicking, Clicking & Tracking Become a Pro environments
🔶 New Quick Play and Become a Pro statistics

[h2]Patch Details[/h2]
🔶 The Quick Play Page needed some love and so that's what we gave it. We used what we learned from the academy and upgraded the quick play levels. Fourteen brand new levels for you to enjoy. Have fun!

🔶 For something completely new, we added a Rookie Range level for new players out there to understand the very basics of aim training and what it's for.

🔶 We added a new type of level called Survival Modes. Here you will be able to play for as long as you can hold on. The better you get, the further you'll make it. Each of these levels will get harder over time so you'll really feel yourself improving as you go on longer and longer runs. Let's go!

🔶 We replaced the old zombie survival level and in it's place we present Android Apocalypse. Good luck staying alive and show these droids what you're made of.

🔶 You will find that we retrofitted new environments in the old Become a Pro levels. Find these changes on the Become a Pro page for the flicking, clicking and tracking levels. Enjoy!

🔶 We overhauled on how statistics work for the Quick Play and Become a Pro levels. This way your leaderboard rank will much more accurately represent your actual skills compared to everyone else. Time to start competing!

notes.title: 3D Aim Trainer: Update Notes - Tracking Academy 2.0
notes.content:
We have updated and overhauled the Tracking Academy completely 🔥. This is the third Academy Update out of four. Tracking Academy 2.0 features 73 new training levels with some awesome new training mechanics specially designed for tracking!
---
[h1]Update Highlights[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Precision Tracking Subskill
[*] New Smoothness Tracking Subskill
[*] New Speed Tracking Subskill
[*] New Reactivity Tracking Subskill
[/list]
---
[previewyoutube=S5dqK9tVD1w;full][/previewyoutube]
---
[h2]Details[/h2]

[b]New Precision Tracking Subskill: [/b]Precision tracking is mostly about improving your ability to track long dodging targets. More predictable move patterns will make it easier for you to focus on your precision.

[b]New Smoothness Tracking Subskill:[/b] This subskill is about combatting mouse stutter. Targets move in easy to read patterns and focusing on smooth tracking is the key to success.

[b]New Speed Tracking Subskill:[/b] Speed is about learning how to track fast moving targets. This will really bump your accuracy once you return to easier to read, slow targets.

[b]New Reactivity Tracking Subskill:[/b] Reactivity is all about your ability to adjust aim on moving targets. Their move patterns are erratic and hard to read, so how fast you can react and adjust is what's being improved here.

notes.title: 3D Aim Trainer: Update Notes - Clicking Academy 2.0
notes.content:
We have updated and overhauled the Clicking Academy completely. 🔥
Clicking Academy 2.0 features 57 new training levels with some awesome new training arena's and new training mechanics!
---
[h1]Update Highlights[/h1]

[list]
[*] New Verified Clicking Subskill
[*] New Point Clicking Subskill
[*] New Efficiency Clicking Subskill
[*] New Reactive Clicking Subskill
[/list]
---
[previewyoutube=h6ldKFDfqno;full][/previewyoutube]
---
[h2]Details[/h2]

[b]New Verified Clicking Subskill:[/b] This subskill is all about target verification. That means that the levels are designed to teach you that you should first confirm your crosshair on the target before you pull the trigger. These levels have accuracy correction, so your score gets reduced if you miss and on top of that your weapons have a reduced rate of fire.

[b]New Point Clicking Subskill:[/b] Point clicking is the art of going fast. No accuracy correction here and no reduced fire rate. Your score depends heavily on the amount of targets you are able to shoot within the time limit. For this reason, the targets are often bigger, but they move faster as well. That means you can shoot more on intuition.

[b]New Efficiency Clicking Subskill:[/b] This subskill is about pathing. That means that you are training yourself how to be efficient at shooting multiple targets. These levels have a bunch of new mechanics ready to be explored.

[b]New Reactive Clicking Subskill:[/b] Reactive clicking trains your reflexes and thus reaction speed. The big difference with point clicking is that the targets will move reactively to your actions, creating a training environment ideal for upping your reflexes.
---

notes.title: 3D Aim Trainer: Update Notes - Flicking Academy 2.0
notes.content:
We have updated and overhauled the Flicking Academy completely with new levels, visuals, weapons and sounds 🔥. This is the first in a series of updates where we will tackle and update the entire academy!
---
[h1]Update Highlights[/h1]

[list]
[*]Updated visuals and sounds on weapons
[*]New training environments
[*]Flicking academy overhaul - Speed, Accuracy
[*]Flicking academy overhaul - Difficulty tiers
[*]Flicking academy overhaul - Statistics
[/list]
---
[previewyoutube=zOAEUfl39IQ;full][/previewyoutube]
---
[h2]Details:[/h2]

[b]Updated visuals and sounds on weapons:[/b] We overhauled all the weapon models to make them more fitting with our highly detailed environments, giving them a cool and fresh new look. We also added new sound effects or updated existing ones to go along with it.

[b]New training environments:[/b] There are a total of 7 new training environments to be played in the updated flicking academy. This with a total of 33 new training levels to be explored.

[b]Flicking academy overhaul - Speed, Accuracy:[/b] The flicking academy is now divided in two main departments: Speed & Accuracy. Each with their own characteristics, levels and scoring system. We feel that this is a mandatory split as they are two sections to be mastered individually.

[b]Flicking academy overhaul - Difficulty tiers:[/b] Both the Speed and Accuracy sections are layered with three different difficulty tiers: Basic, Intermediate and Advanced. These provide a much bigger challenge to the particular aiming sub-skills in question.

[b]Flicking academy overhaul - Statistics:[/b] We've added a whole bunch of new statistics you can track and monitor. Things like TTK, kill-ratio, crit accuracy, time2target, reaction speed, ... This will make it a lot easier and more detailed to view your progress over time in a variety of interesting ways.
---

notes.title: 3D Aim Trainer: Update Notes - January 13, 2022
notes.content:
The "Become A Pro" section has been added to the game and combines the assessment and academy in an easy to use overview that allows you to monitor and practice more efficiently.
---
[previewyoutube=WCjtjSHXp6s;full][/previewyoutube]
---

[h1]Update Highlights[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added "Become A Pro" section
[*] Assessment overview tree
[*] Play assessment levels separately
[*] Easy overview of academy levels
[/list]

---

[h2]Details:[/h2]

[b]Added "Become A Pro" section:[/b] The old assessment and academy have been combined in one section called "Become A Pro". Here you can easily track and monitor which sub-skills you need to improve on and where you rank.

[b]Assessment overview tree:[/b] When you click the "Become A Pro" section, you will see the assessment overview tree. This gives you the ability to easily see all the different sub-skills, each of their separate levels and how each of them add to your Global Aim Rank.

[b]Play assessment levels separately:[/b] You can now play each of the assessment levels by themselves without having to go through all the sub-skills. This makes it a lot easier to assess one part of your aim skill.

[b]Easy overview of academy levels:[/b] Because of the new UI and "Become A Pro" section, it's now much more straightforward to see what academy levels work for which assessment gamemodes. This way you can easily practice and re-assess the skills you need to focus on.

---

notes.title: 3D Aim Trainer: Update Notes - September 29, 2021
notes.content:
A new update for your 3DAT Steam version is arriving today. We made some crucial bug fixes and added some cool new stuff for you to enjoy.
---

[h1]Update Highlights[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added restart functionality
[*] New in-game HUD
[*] New in-game Menu
[*] Reworked environments (check details)
[*] Bug Fixes
[/list]

---

[h2]Details:[/h2]

[b]Added restart functionality:[/b] Players now have the option to restart a training level by pressing 'escape' and select 'restart' from the menu.

[b]New in-game HUD:[/b] We overhauled the HUD so it's easier to read while playing. It now also has a visual effect when you are getting low on bullets or when time is running out, making it easier to identify even without paying attention to it.

[b]New in-game Menu:[/b] Once you're in a training level you can go to the menu by pressing 'escape'. Here we added some new features along with making everything easier to navigate through.

[b]Reworked environments:[/b] On the Tile Frenzy, Sphere Clash, Iron Ball and Go Figure training levels we updated the environments to boost visual recognition. We also just made it look very cool!

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Assessment related percentiles and values were shown as 'NaN'.
[*] Fixed a bug on Flicking levels where the hit and kill sounds seemed not set on the volume slider.
[*] Fixed a bug where on sometimes the default resolution got messed up and black bars were shown.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player and the target angle spawn location was out of sync. This on Eagle's Nest.
[*] Fixed a bug on Burst Flick where new targets would spawn before the previous ones were shot.
[/list]

---

notes.title: 3D Aim Trainer: Update Notes - September 23, 2021
notes.content:
A new update for your 3DAT Steam version is arriving today, and we added some handy features that will make the game feel more intuitive. We also fixed some bugs and added some extra guidance for newer players.
---

[h1]Update Highlights[/h1]

[list]
[*] Landing page
[*] Onboarding tutorials
[*] Intuitive Academy progression
[*] Enhanced level-loading mechanism
[*] More accurate Assessment percentiles
[*] Bug Fixes
[/list]
---

[h2]Details:[/h2]

[b]Landing Page:[/b] We created a new landing page for when you open the Steam app. Here you get a quick overview of all the most common options, along with showing your Global Aim Rank. This landing page will allow us to add more nifty and cool features in the future.

[b]Onboarding Tutorials:[/b] When you open the Assessment, Academy or Quick Play menu's for the first time, you will receive a short instructional guide on how everything works and why you should use. This will guide newer players to the tools they need.

[b]Intuitive Academy Progression:[/b] The academy is about progressing through difficulty levels in order to find your threshold and reach higher plateaus. We saw that some users skipped a lot of levels only to underperform on greater difficulties. This fixes this issue.

[b]Enhanced Level-Loading Mechanism:[/b] We reworked the manner and upgraded the efficiency of how the game loads levels. This should now be an even smoother and faster endeavour.

[b]More Accurate Assessment Percentiles:[/b] Your Assessment scores are now being calculated more precise, giving you more detailed statistics when evaluating your gameplay and progress over time.
---
